# meta_tags.mkv: the metadata ffprobe shows (generate_fixtures.py).
start 0
format
tag title=Tagged
tag encoder=hand
tag ALBUM/ARTIST=Someone
tag ALBUM/ARTIST/SORT_WITH=One, Some
tag ALBUM/TITLE-fre=Titre
tag ALBUM/TITLE-eng=Title
tag ALBUM/TITLE=Titel
tag ALBUM/TITLE-ger=Titel
tag comment=second
tag track=5
tag track=7
tag performer=Lead
tag =empty name
tag EMPTY_LANG=x
tag NUL_LANG-=y
tag NUL_VALUE=cut
tag 
tag A=a
tag A/B-fre=b
tag A/B-fre/C=c
tag track=9
tag /SLASHED=s
tag SECOND/AFRESH=global
stream 0 track
tag language=fre
tag title=Picture
stream 1 track
tag TITLE=Shared
tag TAGGED=yes
stream 2 track
tag language=eng
tag stereo_mode=left_right
tag alpha_mode=1
tag TITLE=Shared
tag TAGGED=yes
stream 3 track
tag enc_key_id=AQIDBAU=
tag language=eng
tag ENCRYPTED=track
stream 4 track
tag language=eng
stream 5 track
tag language=eng
